artistic_preparation.visual_reference: reference_visuelle_extraite.png extracted from earlier approved Turner-style infographic
artistic_preparation.known_composition_mismatch: The approved artistic derivative makes the boat much larger and moves the lighthouse to the far right; the actual original has a small left boat and a center-right lighthouse. Therefore faithful-to-original quality cannot be claimed.

cli_origin: previously user-supplied private Library archive; executed locally; release checksum/commit correspondence not independently verified
method: Manual semantic ownership polygons for boat hull, individual sails, lighthouse, lantern, rigging and rocks; clouds/sea/foam assigned by role before per-family palette segmentation. SVG mask import into editable OSP. Prior OSP was not reused.

artistic_gate.v3: 138 semantic masks, coarser but loses detail

fidelity.reason: Native semantic SVG OSP does not embed source image; fidelity command cannot compare pixels

validation.self_review: Boat and lighthouse legible in approved derivative, but drastic composition mismatch to immutable original; foam simplified, 1413 trims excessive; rejects as finished embroidery.

lessons: Keep prior artistic reconstruction as a style and preparation asset, but never confuse it with the true Turner source.
Before digitizing, compare composition and identity of lighthouse, boat and major wave to original; approved derivative is materially displaced.
Per-family stitch angles improved preview more than naive reduction of regions; directional skeleton guides added spiral artifacts.
Lower trims alone does not make the coarser V3 preferable; high trims still block machine recommendation.
Imported SVG OSP lacks embedded source; fidelity CLI is unavailable even though other checks run.
